name: Soda can
headline: height
subtitle: Standard 12 US fl oz (355 mL) aluminum can
description: The standard North American drink can holds 12 US fluid ounces (355 mL), with a separate, narrower lid. Can maker Ball Corporation's industry-standard drawing gives the aluminum body a 2.600 in (66.04 mm) outside diameter and a height of 4.812 in (122.22 mm). The top narrows to a smaller neck so that a smaller lid can be used.

measures.label: Height
measures.note: Flanged can height (122.22 mm), tolerance +/- 0.015 in, measured on the open can body before the lid is seamed on

measures.label: Body diameter
measures.note: Body outside diameter 2.600 in (66.04 mm), tolerance +/- 0.008 in

measures.label: Fill volume
measures.note: 12.00 US fl oz (355.00 mL) fill volume, not the total internal volume

facts.text: Ball's standard 12 oz can is designated 202/211 x 413: a 211 body diameter, a 413 height and a necked-in 202 lid.
The neck at the top of the can has a plug diameter of 2.063 in (52.40 mm), narrower than the 2.600 in body.

sources.publisher: Ball Corporation (Metal Beverage Container Operations), hosted by CanSource
sources.title: Product standard CS-A0934: 12 oz 202/211 x 413 necked and flanged can, industry standard manufacturing specifications

caveats: Ball's height is for the open, flanged can body before the lid is seamed on; no primary source was found for the height of a sealed can, which differs slightly.
No can-maker source for the weight of an empty or full can was found, so mass is left out.
The Ball drawing is hosted on a distributor's site (CanSource), not on ball.com.
